besluite.fout: 'baie van sy ma gehou' is flat for a son's love of his mother
besluite.rede: 'Was baie lief vir' is the natural Afrikaans for this and keeps the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'verslae van die tyd' copies English 'reports of the time'
besluite.rede: 'Verslae uit daardie tyd' is the idiomatic way to name contemporary accounts; meaning unchanged.

besluite.fout: the compound is hyphenated without need, unlike 'routydperk' in the same lesson
besluite.rede: AWS writes the compound as one word; the protected 'rou' stays intact inside it.
'Afgedwing' (enforced) and 'opgelê' (imposed) say different things, so the meaning moves.

besluite.fout: the embedded clause ending in 'nie' runs straight into the main verb and makes the reader stumble
besluite.rede: The comma closes the relative clause before 'is gedood' and reads more easily, without changing meaning.

besluite.fout: 'dit' can be read as the exaggerated 'dinge' rather than the reports
besluite.rede: Naming 'dié verslae' removes the ambiguity and keeps the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'dit gedoen' is a vague verb for a murder
besluite.rede: 'Die moord gepleeg' is the exact fixed expression and names the same deed.
The sentence opens with 'Sy halfbroers', so the parallel 'sy leërs' clearly means Shaka; the change adds a repeated name without need.
''n eie huis opsit' is already natural Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'en leiers se mag' reads as part of the relative clause, so the double subject is unclear
besluite.rede: Putting 'leiers se mag' first makes both subjects clear with the same meaning.
